about: The two skills with zero invocations, ever, across 437 transcripts: mcp-server-shipping and
polite-mcp-conventions. They also sit first in the listing-drop order, so if the budget ever
overflows they lose their descriptions before anything else - a skill at zero stays at zero.
Both descriptions lead with tool vocabulary - `[project.scripts]`, `uv tool install`,
`claude mcp add`, `inv dev-env.setup`, `AskUserQuestion`, `CDP` - which is the exact shape that
produced a silent miss for invoke-task-conventions on 2026-08-31. These prompts are phrased the
way the problem is felt rather than the way the tool is named.
CONFOUND, stated because it changes how a failure here should be read: polite-mcp-conventions
triggers partly on which repo the session is in, and this harness runs every case in a scratch
directory with no repo context at all. Its cases therefore name the repo in the prompt, the way
a person would when asking about it from elsewhere. A miss on those is weaker evidence than a
miss on the mcp-server-shipping cases, which carry no such dependency.
